title: Google Shopping Scraper
description: Search Google Shopping for product offers, merchants, prices, ratings, and review counts. Batch product phrases in one run to compare retail listings or monitor prices.

batch.title: Product queries
batch.description: Product phrases to search in Google Shopping.
batch.valueDescription: q used to run this search.

schema.description: Location name encoded as a best-effort canonical UULE. Cannot be used with uule; provide uule directly for exact targeting.
Encoded Google location. Cannot be used with location.
desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.
Only return small-business results. Cannot be used with shoprs.
Opaque Google Shopping filter token. Cannot be used with small_business.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Google Shopping by product keyword and collect offers, merchants, prices, ratings, and review counts. Compare listings and monitor retail pricing.
storeCopy.intro: Collect Shopping offers for multiple phrases. Results include product names, merchants, prices, ratings, review totals, categories, and thumbnails.
useCases: Retail teams can compare merchant offers and displayed prices.
E-commerce analysts can track ratings and review counts across products.
Category managers can collect product links for assortment reviews.
howToUse: Add one product phrase to `queries` for each Shopping search.
Use `maxPages` to bound collection and `maxResults` to cap offers.
Compare merchant, price, rating, and review fields.

faqs.question: Are prices normalized to one currency?
faqs.answer: The Actor returns source price text. Use the displayed market and currency context when comparing offers.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Position of the offer in Google Shopping results, starting at 1.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Product category assigned to the shopping offer.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Product name displayed for this Google Shopping offer.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.description: Product image preview URL supplied with the offer.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Displayed offer price and currency when provided by the merchant.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Average customer rating shown for the product.

fields.name: reviews
fields.description: Number of customer reviews shown for the product.

fields.name: input_q
fields.description: Product search phrase submitted to Google Shopping.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this shopping offer was collected.
